per_cpu_util_caveat: per_cpu_util is NOT a capacity signal under a cgroup quota: it measures utilization of the 32 OS-visible CPUs, not the 2-CPU quota. A 100% per-CPU reading on 2 CPUs is only 6.25% of host capacity.
